_comment: Themed circuits (v3_content_plan PART A): curated, ORDERED arena rotations with a difficulty arc. Level ids resolve to res://levels/<id>.json (same as PartyMatch.LEVEL_POOL). Played in authored order, looping, when MatchConfig.arena_mode == CIRCUIT.

mayhem_mile._comment: The first WILD gimmick-BRAWL circuit (v6_party_gimmicks_circuits.md). 8 ~10s lethal-hazard chaos stages on an ESCALATING wildness arc: single readable hazard (t1) -> bigger single-family threat (t2) -> multi-hazard chaos + the collapsing-arena finale (t3). Every stage is a real BRAWL stage (off-screen-kill through-line, flight-required 680px void gaps, symmetric telegraphed dodgeable hazards). Ordered loop (the shipped format); the ~20-authored/10-drawn pool is a later enhancement.
